messages.subject: Gray Screen
parts:
My application is deployed and working.  However, the users have let me know that during their use, eventually the screen goes gray and they have to refresh.

Why is this happening?  If it is just timing out, is there a way to increase the time?  How can I prevent this?

Thanks,
Carrie

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Gray Screen
parts:
Carrie,

This could be related to two things. First, depending on how many users are using your application simultaneously, you could be running out of memory. This is possible if your application uses large amounts of memory for each user session. To address this, you could try increasing your application instance size in the application settings page, or by using the configureApp() function of the shinyapps package.

Second this could be related to the 'Worker Connection Timeout' setting on the application settings page (under Advanced). This setting controls how long a session is allowed to be idle before it is closed. Idle session refer to sessions where the broswer tab is open but not being used. You can increase this setting if you wish (however it should be noted that you still consume instance hours even when a session is idle).

-Andy
